examples.why: Keeps every rule of the training log.
IV Liquid occurs 2 times. In the training log it occurs at most 1 time per case.
ER Registration is missing. Every case of the training log contains it.
IV Antibiotics occurs without CRP. Every training case with IV Antibiotics also contains CRP.
Admission NC occurs 4 times and Leucocytes 1 times, a difference of 3. In the training log the difference stays between -70 and 2.
